summary.en: Jazz combines neuroscience and oncology discovery with major new uses of existing medicines. Its late-stage portfolio includes zanidatamab, dordaviprone, cannabidiol and Vyxeos indication expansions alongside earlier acquired and collaborative candidates.
summary.zh: Jazz将神经科学和肿瘤研发与现有药物的重要新用途相结合。其后期组合包括zanidatamab、dordaviprone、cannabidiol和Vyxeos适应症拓展,以及早期收购和合作的候选药物。

gaps: Company-wide numerical phase totals were not verified. No next milestones were established beyond the ACTION and JZP6979 forecasts.
Zanidatamab is Phase 3 for HERIZON-BTC-302 and the post-T-DXd EmpowHER study in the November Q3 filing. The live webpage labels first-line BTC regulatory; no separate filing was established.
First-line gastroesophageal zanidatamab is already approved and remains excluded. Cannabidiol’s existing-indication capsule filing is not substituted for its Phase 3 DEE programme.

Vyxeos broader AML remains Phase 3 in the November pipeline. The Q3 filing does not include it in the selected development table; its current indication-level status is not reconciled across those two sources.
Origins remain unverified for Vyxeos and JZP047. JZP047 target is undisclosed; cannabidiol’s specific molecular target was not established.
Modalities remain unverified for JZP3507, JZP815, JZP269 and JZP047. Vyxeos is represented as other for its liposomal two-drug formulation.
JZP6979 is Phase 2 in the pipeline chart; the Q3 release describes KYRON as Phase 1b/2a.
The May 2026 JZP898 asset-purchase agreement predates June 2026 and supports provenance; current phases use November 2026 materials.
